title: Frozen ImpulseBuy futures-volume observational analysis
input_policy: All analytic values derive only from cohort.json and metadata.json. No DB, network, live edits, or auxiliary price files were used.

cohort_integrity.assertion: 188 input rows are 188 unique tracker IDs; this verifies export identity, not fills or independently verified production executions.

definitions_and_method.primary_predictor: trigger_candle_volume_mult: recorded closed 30-minute impulse trigger-candle quote-volume divided by the baseline of the previous 20 closed 30-minute candles; the frozen export has no absolute trigger/baseline USD values.
definitions_and_method.secondary_predictor: entry_fut_vol_mult: separate generic persisted futures-volume multiplier; do not substitute it for the exact closed trigger metric. Current scanner source computes its generic multiplier from current-volume/average-volume and may apply cross-exchange confirmation; the current bar can be forming, and the export does not identify each row's historical branch.
definitions_and_method.outcome: Entry-basis-anchored maximum high and first +5/+10/+20% high threshold hits in frozen 15-minute BingX forward windows.
definitions_and_method.primary_path_sample: Per horizon require mature_at_capture=true, coverage_complete=true, valid buckets equal expected, zero invalid bars, and zero duplicate bars. All 188 statuses, including cancelled and reclassified rows, remain eligible.
definitions_and_method.spearman_ci: Spearman rank correlations with percentile 95% intervals from 1200 deterministic symbol-cluster bootstrap replicates; symbols are sampled as clusters so repeated token events stay together.
definitions_and_method.selection_and_cutoffs: The exact closed trigger metric has a 1.5x evaluator gate; the fired cohort is selected at or above that threshold, so results cannot identify performance below 1.5x or validate that threshold against rejected candidates.
definitions_and_method.peaks_are_not_fills: Observed highs are path excursions, not executed trades, fill prices, or PnL.

horizon_semantics.hit_times: 15m bar open and bar close are approximate threshold times; same-bar target/stop overlaps are explicitly flagged
horizon_semantics.coverage_rule: all expected aligned buckets from ceil(entry,15m) through floor(entry+horizon,15m)-15m; valid OHLC; zero invalid or duplicate bars; exact endpoints
horizon_semantics.preclose_rule: separate tracker closed_at-bounded path for non-cancelled closed rows; not evidence of a fill
horizon_semantics.closed_bar_filter: open >= detected_at; open + 15m <= horizon endpoint and capture asof

outlier_flag_sensitivity.warning: The three flagged large forward paths are retained in primary results. An extreme reached later within a horizon is not automatically invalid for that horizon; exclusion is a sensitivity only.

secondary_status_and_pnl_warning: Tracker status and pnl_percent are descriptive snapshot fields; they are not used as primary criteria and do not establish a fill or realized trade PnL.
limitations: This is a fired-only retrospective cohort with a closed-trigger-volume selection floor of 1.5x; no below-floor control cohort is present.
Forward path data are observations, not fills, and maximum highs can substantially overstate attainable outcomes.
No trigger or baseline absolute USD volume is exported, and no absolute futures 24-hour volume is available.

The generic futures multiplier is not interchangeable with the exact closed trigger-candle multiplier; a secondary source-code inspection indicates its scanner path uses current volume versus history and can include cross-exchange confirmation/adjustment. It can reflect a forming 30m bar and is not asserted to be pure BingX for every row.
The exact volume metric, futures-taker metric, and strict horizon coverage are missing for different subsets; every statistic has its own raw matched denominator.
The legacy records carry incomplete entry metrics; null remains missing and was never backfilled.
Correlations and threshold splits are exploratory associations, not causal effects; estimates are small-cohort, symbol-cluster bootstraps and may be unstable.
The preclose export is selected to applicable non-cancelled closed rows; it is supplementary only and cannot represent all candidates or verified entered trades.
No threshold recommendation, gate change, or multiple-threshold search is made.
